reuse.why: Changes the existing getRangeMidpoint/getScheduledAmount pair in place and routes forecast through the range helper, though forecast and schedule-template keep their own number/range dispatch instead of calling getScheduledAmount.

duplication.why: Removes forecast's inline midpoint copy; the remaining local `typeof number ? value : range(...)` dispatches in forecast and schedule-template mirror getScheduledAmount.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts where the range helper and getScheduledAmount already live.

scope.why: Only the helper, its two server callers and tests change.

maintainability.why: The range rule is a single function every path uses; leftover Math.round calls on an integer endpoint and per-site dispatch are minor noise.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All range sites call getRangeWorstCase directly or through getScheduledAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: The per-site number/range dispatch is pre-existing and open, not a disguised copy.

one_place.where: shared/schedules.ts getRangeWorstCase (renamed from getRangeMidpoint), used by getScheduledAmount, forecast-schedules and schedule-template.
